name: Üstten görünüşlü orak biçme animasyonu

prompt.text: Create a polished, game-ready 2D sprite sheet to replace the mowing animation for the SAME youthful farmhand character shown in the reference: same tan flat cap, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, navy-blue overalls, brown boots, and curved hand scythe. Preserve identity, colors, friendly storybook painterly style, and realistic proportions from the reference. The camera must be TRUE VERTICAL TOP-DOWN / overhead, orthographic: looking straight down at the character and ground, no horizon, no isometric tilt, no diagonal three-quarter side view, no profile angle, no perspective. This is a clean transparent PNG sprite atlas with exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, total 16 cells, each cell showing one full character at the same scale and centered, with comfortable transparent padding. No cell borders, grid lines, labels, symbols, shadows outside cells, background, grass, or text. Columns are facing directions in this exact order: north/up, west/left, south/down, east/right. Rows are one continuous mowing cycle in this exact order: 1) ready stance with scythe held back, 2) raising and beginning the pull, 3) powerful low sweeping cutting stroke across the grass, blade extended and clearly visible, 4) follow-through and recovery returning to ready. Every row must show a visibly different phase; the scythe and hands move through the arc so it reads as repeated active cutting rather than a static pose. Keep the body/feet/hat orientation consistent with each column and phase; show the cap and shoulders clearly from overhead. Crisp clean silhouette and transparent edges, suitable for frame-by-frame animation in a mobile game.

technical_notes: 4×4 atlas sampled by Flame; each row advances continuously at 6 fps while the cutting point ahead of the player is on uncut grass. Display aspect ratio preserves the 4:3 atlas cells.
